rows.en:
(Luis-san asked me to come
to Arlington Cemetery, but...)
rows.notes: Arlington Cemetery is provisional in locations.json.

rows.en:
(Come to think of it, this is the first time
Luis-san has ever called me out somewhere.)

(Or rather,
it's the first time we've even arranged to meet...
Until now, we only ever ran into each other.)

(When I think about it, we really have
bumped into each other a lot...)

Hey, Fresh Boy.
Sorry for dragging you all the way out here.

Oh, Luis-san...
Why Arlington Cemetery today?
There's someone I really want you to meet.

Someone you want me to meet?
You don't mean...?

Yeah, that's right. This here's my old
brother-in-arms...
(So Luis-san's friend really is gone...)
rows.notes: Japanese has no subject ('already passed away...'); restored as 'Luis-san's friend' to stay gender-neutral.

rows.en:
We joined the military at the same time.
We clicked, and pulled a lot of dumb stunts
together.

He was always mouthing off, but he was a damn
good pilot. He was a lot younger than me, too,
so I treated him like my own kid brother.
rows.notes: Gender of the late friend: the Japanese never states it; 'he' rests on Luis loving him 'like a real younger brother' (jitsu no otouto mitai ni).

rows.en: He always gave me the happiest smile...
He was such a great pilot... So why......!

Something went wrong while he was testing
a plane for the military...
A freak accident, as they say.

I couldn't accept what happened. I was lost,
and I stopped letting myself get close to people.

I didn't want to feel that kind of grief again,
like when I lost my comrade...

It's a joke. Before I knew it, my soul
had turned into a gutless chicken.
But that ends today!
Let me introduce you, buddy...
rows.notes: Luis speaks to the dead friend (senyuu) at the grave.

rows.en: This here's my new soulmate!!
(He thinks that highly of me...)

Well... introductions are done.
Let's head home.

Luis-san!
I'll keep working hard to become a red-hot man
overflowing with passion!

Sure you can. You're a man I've recognized,
after all.
(Luis-san recognized me as his soulmate...)

(I'll be a man worthy of being Luis-san's
soulmate... I'll give it my all!)

(Come to think of it, this is the first time
Luis-san has ever called me out somewhere.)

(Or rather, it's the first time we've even
arranged to meet... Until now, we only ever
ran into each other.)

(When I think about it, we really have
bumped into each other a lot...)

Hey, Fresh Girl.
Sorry for dragging you all the way out here.
He always gave me the happiest smile.
(He thinks that highly of me...)

Luis-san!
I'll keep working hard to become a red-hot woman
overflowing with passion!

Sure you can. You're a woman I've recognized,
after all.
(Luis-san recognized me as his soulmate...)

(I'll be a woman worthy of being Luis-san's
soulmate... I'll give it my all!)
(I just sort of ended up at Arlington Cemetery...)

Yo, Fresh Boy...
No, I mean... if it ain't my soulmate.
Oh, Luis-san.
You came to visit his grave too?
I'm sure he's happy about it, too...

Whoa, if he saw me getting all sentimental,
he'd laugh at me.
Well, guess I'll head home.

(Please watch over me...
I'll do my best too, so I can be worthy
of being Luis-san's soulmate!)
rows.notes: Addressed to the late friend at the grave.

rows.en: (I just sort of ended up at Arlington Cemetery...)

Yo, Fresh Girl...
No, I mean... if it ain't my soulmate.

(Please watch over me...
I'll do my best too, so I can be worthy
of being Luis-san's soulmate!)

(Pinon-chan gave me a letter...
C-could it be a love letter?!)
rows.notes: The letter was handed over by Pinon (Luis's letter, delivered).

rows.en: (Well, I'd better check what's inside first...)
(Let's see...)
(Wait, this letter's from Luis-san?!)

(A letter? What's going on?
Let's see...)

By the time you read this letter...
I probably won't be around anymore......
(Huh?!)

Forgive me for leaving without a word to you.
If you tried to stop me, my resolve would waver...

(No way...
Don't shut me out like that, Luis-san!!)
rows.notes: mizukusai = keeping your friend in the dark.

rows.en:
I wandered in a whirlpool of loneliness
and found a single ray of light.
That was you, my soulmate!

At times that light burns hot
and gives off a flash too bright to look at.
Honestly, right now I'm not sure I can take it.

To become a man worthy of you,
I need to polish my mind and body
just a little more.

So I'm setting out on a journey. I don't know
when I'll be back. I thought long and hard
about this... Please forgive me.

It's too late now, and it'll only sound like
an excuse, but I'll tell you anyway...

I'm sure that radiance of yours
shouldn't keep shining on me alone.

There must be lots of people who need you now.
With those hands of yours, save as many
of them as you can.

That will be the cornerstone of a peaceful
future for the Frontier... no, for the
whole galaxy.

Don't worry, you can do it.
After all, you saved me.

Hey, don't worry about me.
I'm just gonna go cool down at high altitude
for a bit.

When you look up and see a contrail in the sky,
maybe it'll be the trail I left behind...
Last of all, I promise you this.

Once I can take your radiance
head-on...
I'll come back to you for sure! I swear it!
(Luis-san...)

P.S.
I'm leaving my bandana in your care.
Take good care of it like it was me.
And finally, I leave you with these words...
MY SOUL FOR YOU!
Thank you, Luis-san...

I'll treasure this bandana
as if it were you, Luis-san...

And you'd better... you'd better come back!
Come back and show me your lively,
passion-filled self again, Luis-san!!

Affinity ending.
Luis female filler.
rows.notes: Developer placeholder text (umeyou = filler) under Alto's name plate; translated literally in the format of c05505.

uncertain: c08635/c08636/c08655 (and the 'he' in c08637-c08666): Luis's late friend is never gendered in the Japanese; 'he' rests on Luis treating him 'like my own younger brother' (c08635). c08633 kept neutral ('Luis-san's friend').
c08644 etc.: soulmeitsu (Luis's pseudo-English plural) rendered as plain 'soulmate'.
c08624/c08629/c08661/c08669: Arlington Cemetery is 'provisional' in locations.json.
c08701: developer placeholder (Alto name plate), translated literally like c05505.
